every frame.description: Runs its lines for every frame. t is the time in seconds. Without it, the piece is a still.

repeat.description: Runs its lines n times, counting i from 0. Leave out "as" and the count is still called i.

for … in.description: Runs its lines once for each item of a list.

if.description: Runs its lines only when the test holds. else (or else if) catches the other case.

if / else.description: Runs its lines only when the test holds. else (or else if) catches the other case.

make.description: Defines your own command. The last line is its result, so it works as a function too.

keep.description: Whatever move, spin, grow, color or width happens inside is undone at the end.

when key.description: Runs when a key is pressed (keys: "space", "enter", arrows like "left", letters and digits). Change values here; draw in every frame.

when click.description: Runs when the canvas is clicked or tapped; mouse holds where.

dot.description:
dot x, y, size [, color]
A filled circle. size is the radius in pixels.

ring.description:
ring x, y, size [, color]
An outlined circle, drawn with the current width.

box.description:
box x, y, w, h [, color]
A filled rectangle centered on x, y.

line.description:
line x1, y1, x2, y2 [, color]
A straight stroke from one point to another.

path.description:
path points [, color]
A stroke through a list of points.

shape.description:
shape points [, color]
A filled shape whose corners are a list of points.

write.description:
write text, x, y [, size] [, color]
Text centered on x, y. size is the letter height in pixels (18 if you leave it out).

piece.description: A small animated piece to start from: a ring of dots that breathes and turns.
